newsitem.title: RWANDA: Senior justice ministry official killed in Rwanda.
newsitem.headline: Senior justice ministry official killed in Rwanda.

text.p: A senior Rwandan justice ministry official was shot dead by gunmen who attacked his house in the Rwandan capital on Friday night, police reported on Saturday.

They said Vincent Nzezabaganwa was gunned down at his house in the Gisozi district of Kigali at 8.00 pm local (2000 GMT) on Friday. Three other people were killed in the shootout that lasted several minutes, neighbours and police said.
"We have not arrested anyone in connection with the killings but we are investigating," a police spokesman said on Saturday.
"As yet we do not have a motive for the killing."
